dashboard_no_api: No connection to Clash API. Make sure sing-box is running and its config enables
dashboard_no_groups: The sing-box config has no outbound groups — nothing to switch.
logs_resume_title: Resume: buffered entries appear at once
logs_empty: No logs yet. The /logs stream opens automatically once sing-box is reachable.
connections_no_api: No connection to Clash API — sing-box is not running.
service_restart_api_down: sing-box restarted, but Clash API did not respond. Check logs.{skipped}
service_running_hint: The service is running — reinstall and uninstall are blocked to avoid disrupting the VPN. Stop sing-box first.
service_config_missing_hint: The sing-box config path is not set — set it in Settings, under the 'sing-box' section.
service_help_restart: A soft restart remembers the selection in selector groups and reapplies it after start — on top of what sing-box restores from
service_tun_requires_service: The config has a TUN inbound: without the service installed, sing-box cannot start.
service_help_installed: Start and stop go through the service manager and need no administrator rights: they were granted to your account at install time. Reinstall is needed if the path to the sing-box binary or the config changed. While the service is running, reinstall and uninstall are blocked — stop sing-box first, or the VPN will drop. After uninstall, sing-box runs as an ordinary process — this works for any config without TUN.
service_help_tun_required: The service is required: the config needs TUN, which means administrator rights. Installation asks for them once; afterwards control works without UAC.
service_help_not_needed: This config does not need the service — it has no TUN, and sing-box runs as an ordinary process under your account. The service is useful if you later add TUN or want sing-box to run without Vantage Box open.
mini_config_missing: The sing-box config path is not set — set it in Settings.
binary_too_old: The version is below the supported range — please update it.
binary_too_new: The version is above the tested range. It will work, but behavior may differ.
binary_manual_hint: The path is set manually, so Vantage Box does not touch this file — it only reports incompatible versions. Clear the 'sing-box file' field in Settings to hand version control to the app.
versions_unsupported_title: Only versions in the tested range are installed automatically
versions_use_title: Make this the working file version
versions_hint: Each version is stored as a separate file and stays on disk until deleted: rolling back needs no re-download. The selected version is copied to the working file the service points at — no reinstall needed.
versions_empty: The list is empty. The refresh button fetches it from GitHub; afterwards it is shown from cache.
versions_manual_banner: The sing-box path is set manually, so Vantage Box does not replace the file. Installing a version from the list below will clear this field and switch the app to its own binary — the old file stays on disk but is no longer used.
versions_confirm_banner: The sing-box path is set manually. Installing version {version} will clear the "sing-box file" field and switch Vantage Box to its own binary. The old file stays on disk but is no longer used.
config_changed_externally_dirty: The file changed outside Vantage Box — unsaved edits will be lost.
config_changed_externally: The file changed outside Vantage Box.
config_saved_restart: Config saved. sing-box reads it only on start — a restart is needed.
config_path_missing_post: is not set. Specify it in Settings, under the 'sing-box' section.
runtime_config_hint: This is the config sing-box was started with — your config.json with the Clash API block (external controller and secret) injected. Line numbers match sing-box error messages.
runtime_config_not_found: The running config does not exist yet — start sing-box at least once.
subs_save_first: Save your changes first — refresh reads the already saved subscriptions.
subs_url_hint: The URL may return a sing-box config with outbounds, a bare array of outbounds, or a base64 list of ss:// vmess:// vless:// trojan:// hysteria2:// tuic://
subs_empty: No subscriptions. 'Add' creates a new one — enter a URL, name, and group.
subs_group_hint: Empty — nodes go to all selector/urltest groups
subs_hint_pre: Nodes and endpoints are loaded into config.json under
subs_hint_post: tags. A subscription that ships its own groups inserts them as new groups, or fills existing groups with the same name; otherwise nodes go into the target groups. On refresh the old managed content is removed, so no duplicates appear. Comments in config.json are not preserved — same as in the config editor.
onboarding_hint: You need the sing-box binary and config.json. You can pick your own or download sing-box right here — the installer does not include it.
onboarding_config_hint: An existing config.json or a minimal one: a local mixed inbound and a 'proxy' selector where subscription nodes will later be loaded in.
onboarding_ready: Done — you can start sing-box with the button in the status bar.
settings_help_language: Switching the language reloads the UI. The 'System' option follows your operating system language.
settings_secret_placeholder: empty — a fresh one each start
settings_help_clash_api: Changing the address, secret, or log level reopens the subscriptions right away — no app restart needed. An empty secret means Vantage Box generates a fresh one each time sing-box starts.
settings_help_singbox: An empty sing-box file path means the binary is managed by the app — versions can then be managed on the 'Service' tab.
settings_help_ui: Node latency is tested against this URL — both by the button in a group card and by auto-switching. Any URL that returns a short response works.
settings_help_autoswitch_mid: seconds the active node of a selector group is pinged against the latency test URL. On failure or delay above the limit, the group switches to the node with the lowest latency.
settings_help_autoswitch_post: groups are not affected — they manage their own choice. A limit of 0 means 'switch only when the node did not answer at all'.
settings_help_tray: The tray icon and start minimized appear after restarting the app — the tray is created once at startup. Start minimized is ignored without the tray: otherwise there would be nothing to open the window with.
settings_hotkey_tab_index_hint: Digits 1–9 jump to the corresponding tab
settings_hotkeys_global: Global — work even when the window is closed
settings_hotkeys_inapp: In-app — only while the window is focused
settings_help_hotkeys_a: Click 'Record', then press the whole combination. Modifiers:
settings_help_hotkeys_b: (Windows key). At least one is required: without a modifier, the hotkey would steal the key from the whole system.
settings_help_hotkeys_c: cancels recording. You can also type the combination by hand, using
settings_help_hotkeys_d: as the separator. Global hotkeys work even when the window is closed; in-app shortcuts only while it is focused.
settings_help_app_update: Updates are downloaded from GitHub and verified by signature. 'Notify' shows a bar with an install button; 'Install automatically' installs and restarts the app without asking.
settings_help_file: The file is read as JSONC — comments and trailing commas are allowed. Edits are picked up on the fly, no restart needed.
status_session_total: Total for the current sing-box session
status_start_blocked: Service required: the config has a TUN inbound
alert_api_down: sing-box is running, but Clash API is not responding. {detail}
alert_tun_admin: The config has a TUN inbound — it needs administrator rights. Install the service.
alert_compat_out_of_range: sing-box version {version} is outside the tested range: the app works, but some features may behave differently.
traffic_hint: A minute of history, shared scale for both series. Peak {peak}
group_auto_title: sing-box picks the choice inside this group itself
jsonc_single_quote_key: A key in single quotes is JSON5. sing-box and serde expect double quotes.
jsonc_unquoted_key: An unquoted key is JSON5. Wrap the name in double quotes.
jsonc_single_quote_string: A string in single quotes is JSON5. Double quotes are required.
jsonc_invalid_token: `{raw}` does not exist in JSON — remove it or replace with a number.
jsonc_json5_number: `{raw}` is JSON5. A plain decimal number is expected, e.g. 1.5 instead of .5.
